item.title: Whiskers 0.8.45
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.45

### Local Models

  • Added built-in local model choices so you can pick the speed and quality tradeoff that fits your Mac
  • Added download and removal controls for local models, so it’s easier to manage storage without leaving Whiskers
  • Improved reliability when downloading or reopening local models, reducing setup issues after interrupted downloads

    • ### Onboarding & Model Setup

  • Redesigned model setup during onboarding so it’s clearer which model to start with and how to continue
  • Improved the model picker across onboarding and Settings so local and cloud options feel more consistent
  • Added clearer status feedback while models are downloading, ready, or need attention

    • ### Improvements

  • Improved dictionary and replacement list layouts so saved items are easier to scan and manage
  • Improved custom vocabulary chips so long terms are easier to read
  • Updated the app update action label to show the available version more clearly
  • Made the Add API key control easier to click

    • ### Bug Fixes

  • Fixed toast notifications so they stay centered and only use as much width as they need
